info.name: MaxPlus Gateway — GhostClaw lane (P098 Rev D)
info.description:
Live-probed contract for the maxplus aggregator gateway.

Every request, model id, status code and error body in this collection came from a real probe on 2026-07-24/25 (stage M2). Nothing here is transcribed from a screenshot or a vendor page.

Source of truth: `config/models.maxplus.json`
Decision record: `docs/decisions/P098-RevD.md`

## Auth

Set `{{maxplus_api_key}}` as a Postman **secret** variable in an environment, or better, in a vault. Never commit a value into this file — the collection ships with an empty default.

## Base URL

`{{base_url}}` must be the bare origin `https://api.maxplus-ai.cc` with **no** `/v1` suffix. A base ending in `/v1` produces `/v1/v1/messages`, which the gateway answers with `403 {"message":"This passthrough route is disabled."}`.

## What this gateway is

An opaque reseller pool: it chooses the upstream provider itself and exposes no pool metadata. `/v1/pools`, `/v1/me`, `/v1/usage`, `/v1/credits` all return `403` (Cloudflare error 1106). Treat every payload sent here as disclosed to a third party.

exec: pm.test('404 for an unknown path', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
// This matters: the gateway answers 404 for paths it does not serve and 401
// for paths it serves but did not authenticate. That makes an unauthenticated
// 401 positive evidence that an endpoint exists.

item.name: empty content at small budget — the M2.4 rule

exec: // M2.4: HTTP 200 with empty content is NOT success. Retry ONCE at
// max_tokens 4096 — some reasoning models spend the whole small budget
// on reasoning tokens before emitting any output. Still empty => EMPTY.
console.log('empty at 64 tokens — this model needs needs_big_budget=true');

request.description: deepseek-v4-flash, glm-5.1 and mimo-v2.5 return 200 with empty content at max_tokens=64 on this schema, and recover at 4096. They carry `needs_big_budget: true` in the registry.

exec: // Guards a real misconfiguration found in the wild: setting

// request /v1/v1/messages. The base URL must be the bare origin.
// Paired with the /models 404 above, this is what makes an unauthenticated

item.name: Guardrails
item.description: Requests that MUST NOT be sent. Present as documentation of the egress redaction gate — do not run them.

item.name: DO NOT RUN — payload the redaction gate blocks

exec: // The egress redaction gate in ghostclaw-providers drops any payload
// containing these markers before it leaves the host, logs DENIED, and
// does not retry. This request exists to document the contract; sending
// it would defeat the control it documents.
throw new Error('Blocked by design: this request carries a secret marker. See ghostclaw-providers::maxplus::redaction_gate.');

request.description: All traffic on this lane transits a third-party reseller. Blocked markers: `-----BEGIN`, `cert.pem`, `.pem`, `.env`, `ccsk-`, `sk-ant-`, `ghp_`, `gho_`, `xoxb-`, `AKIA`, `CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `CHANNEL_SECRET`, `LINE_CHANNEL`, `MAXPLUS_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `GLM_API_KEY`, `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`.
